node.title: Re: Record separator in variable
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: How you best solve this depends on how many escape sequences you want to support. For example, in this case a simple s/\\n/\n/g; s/\\r/\r/g; might be enough, but there are also modules such as [mod://String::Interpolate] to give you the full power of Perl's interpolation (which may be too much power for the users of the configuration file). I would stay away from [doc://eval] unless you are absolutely certain that you can always trust your input.
